newsitem.title: MACAU: Taipei Business Bank to open Macau branch.
newsitem.headline: Taipei Business Bank to open Macau branch.

text.p: Taipei Business Bank will open a fully-licensed branch in the Portuguese-administered enclave of Macau on January 9, banking sources said on Friday.
The branch office, already under construction in the city centre, would be the first for a Taiwanese bank in Macau, which borders the southern Chinese province of Guangdong.
No other details were immediately available.
Taipei Business Bank applied to Macau authorities in January this year to set up the branch.

A bank spokesman said at the time that Taiwanese banks, eyeing Taiwan's huge trade and investment links to China, have shown an interest in Macau as there are fewer restrictions on banking operations than in neighbouring Hong Kong.
Taiwan has banned direct contact, including banking communications, with China since a civil war ended in 1949. All contacts must be conducted through a third region, usually Hong Kong.
